entries.01d76a0e0b81c0b3: This business produces color filters for displays, antireflection films, photomasks (circuit masters for semiconductors), and semiconductor package substrates. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥185,875 million, a 34.3% decrease from the previous year. In semiconductor-related products, FC-BGA substrates obtained several certifications for advanced products and demand for communications applications increased, but revenue decreased due to the effect of shifting Tekscend Photomask Corporation to an equity-method affiliate. entries.481f6d16a1bbdc1f: This business produces securities, cards, business forms, and printed materials such as catalogs, books and magazines, and also handles BPO services that carry out operations on behalf of companies and government bodies, as well as digital sales support. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥903,930 million, the largest of the three reportable segments, up 1.0% year on year. In digital business-related operations, marketing DX increased, and revenue rose, also helped by the expansion of the government ID business and the effects of acquisitions. On the other hand, BPO-related revenue declined due to the reaction to one-time projects in the previous year, and communication media-related revenue declined as publishing and commercial printing decreased. The publishing and printing business has been consolidated into TOPPAN Chlore Co., Ltd.
entries.4be0e8af379d8778: This field produces flexible packaging materials, paper containers, liquid composite containers, plastic molded products, contract and entrusted filling, transparent barrier films, and exterior materials for lithium-ion secondary batteries, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, packaging for food and other uses grew overseas, the new plant in Czechia began full-scale operation and sales of the monomaterial transparent barrier film “GL BARRIER” expanded, and the flexible packaging business of SONOCO PRODUCTS COMPANY and the acquisition effect of Irplast S.p.A. also contributed, so revenue increased. Domestically, SX packaging using films made with recycled materials spread under the sustainable brand “SMARTS.”

entries.8aed5b4d6582e525: This field produces photomasks and FC-BGA substrates, which are high-density package substrates on which semiconductor chips are mounted. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, FC-BGA substrates obtained several certifications for advanced products, and demand for communications applications increased. At the Ishikawa Plant, the company is advancing the launch of a pilot line for next-generation semiconductor packages, and at the Niigata Plant a new production line for high-end products has started operation. It also participates in the Japan-US mixed consortium “US-JOINT.” On the other hand, because Tekscend Photomask Corporation was shifted to an equity-method affiliate, revenue decreased for the business as a whole, but excluding this effect, revenue increased.

entries.aac6f2281a3e202b: This business produces flexible packaging materials, paper containers and liquid containers that wrap food and daily necessities, building materials such as decorative sheets used for floors and walls of homes, and ink. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥715,227 million, up sharply by 32.0% year on year. In packaging-related operations, as the EU's Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) took effect in February 2025 and the switch to environmentally friendly packaging materials accelerated in earnest, the new plant in the Czech Republic began full-scale operation, and sales of the transparent barrier film 'GL BARRIER' expanded. Also helped by the effects of the acquisitions of the flexible packaging business of SONOCO PRODUCTS COMPANY and Irplast S.p.A., revenue rose. Building materials-related revenue also rose, due to expanded sales of decorative sheets in Europe and the United States, among other factors.

entries.e8583f4804a41a3d: From fiscal 2026, it has begun the Medium-term Management Plan 2028, and the key concept of its target vision through fiscal 2031 is “True Value Transformation.” It states that it will raise social value and economic value by solving the issues of customers and society. Its 3 management issues are Business Portfolio Transformation, Corporate Reform, and Balance Sheet Reform. For Business Portfolio Transformation, it divides all businesses into 4 categories by growth potential and profitability: “priority growth businesses,” “strategic focus businesses,” “stable expansion businesses,” and “improvement and transformation businesses.” It states that it will allocate funds generated by stable expansion businesses to growth businesses while carrying out structural reform centered on improvement and transformation businesses. For Balance Sheet Reform, it states that it will reduce held assets and accelerate the sale of policy-held shares.
